adaptation.rule: Landscape screenshots default to 1440px PC layout width unless the user specifies another width.

strategy: Re-rendered the FlowMail integrations dashboard from the regenerated design-token and UI-DSL artifacts.
Rendered the page inside the shared React/Tailwind lab framework from the page-local v2 artifacts.
Used normalized 1440px desktop proportions for sidebar, topbar, page spacing, metric grid, and integration card grid.
Used local SVG/CSS logo approximations for visible integration marks instead of network assets.

mobile.sidebar: normal top navigation area with horizontal nav scroll

verification_observed: Desktop browser check showed the sidebar remained visible while the integrations content area changed scroll position.
Desktop browser check showed the global topbar remained pinned at the top of the app pane during content scroll.

shadow_mapping.policy: Treat elevation as high-risk; do not map low elevation mechanically.

commands.command: rg -n "FlowMail|All Integrations|Request Integration|Raxon|Crypto|Bitcoin|Export Report|shadow-card|shadow-soft" src dist
commands.notes: Required FlowMail text is present in source/build output. Old unrelated Raxon/Crypto/Bitcoin/Export Report text is absent from src.
Desktop shell and scoped scroll classes are present. No shadow-card/shadow-soft usage remains in src/pages/flowmail/FlowMailPage.jsx.

browser_checks.notes: An existing Vite tab on 41739 reflected the updated page. It showed FlowMail, All Integrations, Request Integration, integration cards, sidebar, topbar, and scoped content scrolling.

limitations: Playwright was not installed in the project, so automated console inspection was not run.
The started dev server for this run is http://127.0.0.1:41740/ because port 41739 was already occupied.
